newsitem.title: USA: Designer Holdings sees pact accretive in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Designer Holdings sees pact accretive in 2nd half.

text.p: Designer Holdings Ltd said Monday it expects a new licensing agreement with Donna Karan International to be neutral to its fourth quarter earnings per share and in the first half of 1997. The company said it expects the pact to be accretive to its earnings beginning in the second half of 1997.
The 30-year pact transfers to Designer Holdings the manufacturing, sales and worldwide distribution of DKNY Jeanswear. The transfer takes place June 1, 1997, the companies said.

Designer Holdings said it expects the license to generate incremental sales of $85-$95 million in the second half of 1997. To launch the new line, it said it will fund an extensive advertising campaign beginning in March, which will continue throughout 1997.
Separately, Designer Holdings said it plans to file an offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission to raise $100 million through the sale of convertible preferred securities.

The shares will be issued by a financing vehicle to be known as Designer Holdings Trust, a Delaware business trust, the company said. The trust will offer for sale trust-originated convertible preferred securities, which will be convertible into Designer Holdings common stock.
